packageRules.description: dsh packages publish real releases on the `next` dist-tag (latest is a placeholder 0.0.1-rc.1); track that channel and bump declared ranges so pre-release ranges keep matching across patch boundaries. Deliberately excludes @deepseek-ai/cordis and @deepseek-ai/schemastery: their `latest` is a real release (4.0.1 / 3.18.1) while `next` is an older prerelease, so following `next` there would downgrade them.
